reserveReview.rationale: The dated mTBILL historical issuer portfolio at 4 November 2026 15:00 UTC reports USTB USD 70.785 million and BUIDL USD 4.828 million against exact equity of USD 75.619202508 million. The historical table matches the signed SAVE aggregate and all named position values. At Ethereum block 26344315 (2026-11-04T22:03:11Z), the authorized registry names the SAVE checkpoint published at 2026-11-04T18:31:35Z. Its UnixFS root, canonical content digest, ECDSA signature and official signing key were independently reproduced. The signature authenticates issuer aggregate claims, not the unsigned itemized composition or independent financial assurance. Direct issuer API access returned HTTP 403; the matched historical JSON was recovered through a read-only relay and observed at 2026-11-04T22:04:05Z. Weights divide rounded named positions by exact equity and retain the full unidentified remainder without renormalization. The separately recovered latest endpoint is a different checkpoint and is not substituted for this signed-hour portfolio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas SAVE-linked historical mTBILL portfolio checkpoint 2026-11-04T15:00; rounded USD-million positions divided by exact reported equity 75.619202508, with explicit unclassified residual
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The matched November 4 checkpoint leaves USD 6,202.508 unidentified by the rounded named-position table (0.008202292267422176%). The Ethereum/Base chain subtotals leave USD 1,102.1244 already contained within that remainder and never added twice. Neither the signed aggregate nor an empty liabilities object establishes a complete itemized book, financial assurance, all-root obligations or pending-redemption reconciliation. Residual instrument identity, custody mapping, governing whole-position liquidity and maturity remain unresolved. Existing custody review and scoped gap classifications retain their original dates. Relay recovery does not repair the production live adapter source-access failure.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The July 17, 2026 mTBILL final terms name Maerki Baumann & Co. AG as custodian and Ankura Trust Company LLC as security agent, with custody and collateral accounts and agreements applicable. Provider shares, the custody mapping of the issuer-reported USTB/BUIDL wallets, and rehypothecation terms remain unresolved. Source-scope correction observed 2026-10-20 withdraws the inherited segregated label: the cited terms identify contractual accounts and security arrangements but do not establish complete-book asset segregation; the custody and collateral agreements themselves were not recovered. The 2026 base prospectus makes a custodian the issuer's service provider, does not automatically confer beneficial ownership on tokenholders, and retains qualified subordination, limited recourse and enforcement-risk warnings. Structured security is retained separately from unproved whole-book segregation. The original October 1 custody review start and all provider facts remain unchanged.
